item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing Sharif explicitly using nuclear capability to cover an offensive military move, territorial seizure, or domestic repression.\nI also did not find a 2024 source showing a direct safeguard failure of this kind.\nThe evidence base is therefore mostly inferential: restraint is visible in public messaging, while the main contrary material is rhetorical brinkmanship rather than documented nuclear shielding of aggression.","evidence":[{"title":"PM voices satisfaction over Pakistan Army’s operational preparedness","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-09-05","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/05-09-2024/pm-expresses-satisfaction-over-pak-armys-operational-preparedness","summary":"Sharif praised operational preparedness, said it helps preserve “the delicate balance of power essential for peace in nuclearized South Asia,” and framed the deterrence regime as imposing costs only “in the event of aggression.” This reads as deterrence and stability language, not a public attempt to hide aggression behind nuclear capability.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.3"]},{"title":"Pakistan's nuclear programme is for peaceful purposes: PM","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-12-24","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/24-12-2024/pm-vows-to-root-out-scourge-of-terrorism","summary":"Sharif said Pakistan’s nuclear program is for peaceful purposes, for self-defense, and has no aggressive designs. That is direct public evidence against using nuclear capability as a shield for offensive or coercive action.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Message on the Occasion of Youm-e-Takbeer on 28th May 2024","publisher":"Press Information Department, Pakistan","date":"2024-05-27","url":"https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/25454","summary":"The government described Pakistan as a responsible nuclear state committed to peaceful resolution of conflicts, stringent controls, comprehensive safety measures, and Credible Minimum Deterrence. This is institutional evidence of a non-offensive nuclear posture.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.3","1B.4"]},{"title":"PM stresses for peaceful solution of global challenges","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-09-27","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/27-09-2024/pm-urges-india-to-engage-in-dialogue-for-resolution-of-jk-dispute","summary":"In the UNGA speech, Sharif referenced “a limited war under the nuclear overhanging” and said Pakistan would respond “most decisively” to Indian aggression. This is not a direct claim that he used nuclear capability to shield aggression, but it is the strongest 2024 rhetoric that places a territorial dispute inside a nuclear coercion frame.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.1","1B.2"]}]}
